title: Azure Modular VNet Template
description: Configurable Azure Virtual Network with public and private subnets and a deny-by-default Network Security Group

environment_name.title: Environment Name
environment_name.description: Identifier prefix applied to all VNet networking resources

location.title: Azure Region
location.description: Azure region where the network resources will be deployed

vnet_address_space.title: VNet Address Space
vnet_address_space.description: IPv4 address space for the Virtual Network (e.g. 10.1.0.0/16)

public_subnet_cidr.title: Public Subnet CIDR
public_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR block for the public (workload-facing) subnet

private_subnet_cidr.title: Private Subnet CIDR
private_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR block for the private (database / internal) subnet

allowed_ssh_cidr.title: Allowed SSH CIDR
allowed_ssh_cidr.description: Permitted IPv4 network block for SSH administrative access. Leave blank to disable inbound SSH.
